characters.name: God
characters.note: Divine Father; not depicted as a human figure unless the text explicitly requires it.

characters.name: Jesus
characters.note: Central figure; depicted as a first-century Jewish man, including crucified and risen forms.

characters.name: Holy Spirit
characters.note: Divine Spirit; depict symbolically or as a nonhuman presence, not ordinarily as a human figure.

characters.name: John

characters.name: Moses
characters.note: Mentioned biblical figure; not active in the Gospel's present scenes.

characters.name: Isaiah
characters.note: Mentioned prophet; not active in the Gospel's present scenes.

characters.name: Elijah
characters.note: Mentioned prophet; not active in the Gospel's present scenes.

characters.name: John’s disciples
characters.note: Group accompanying John or discussing Jesus.

characters.name: Priests and Levites
characters.note: Delegation questioning John.

characters.name: Pharisees
characters.note: Religious opponents or authorities; sometimes a collective group.

characters.name: The disciple whom Jesus loved
characters.note: Unnamed disciple, traditionally identified with John; keep distinct from John the Baptist.

characters.name: Andrew
characters.note: Disciple of Jesus.

characters.name: Simon Peter
characters.note: Disciple and apostle.

characters.name: Philip
characters.note: Disciple of Jesus.

characters.name: Nathanael

characters.name: Mary, mother of Jesus
characters.note: Present at Cana and the crucifixion.

characters.name: Jesus’ brothers

characters.name: Servants at Cana

characters.name: Bridegroom at Cana

characters.name: Samaritans of Sychar

characters.name: Rooster

brief.era: First-century Roman Judea and Galilee, during the Jewish festivals and the ministry, death, and resurrection of Jesus.
brief.place: Galilee, Judea, Samaria, Jerusalem, villages, roads, lakeshore, temple courts, homes, gardens, and tombs.
brief.dress: First-century Jewish clothing: tunics, mantles, head coverings, sandals; John the Baptist in austere prophetic dress; Roman soldiers in military gear; priests and officials in status-appropriate robes.
brief.buildings_and_objects: Temple courts, synagogue, wedding house, stone water jars, well, pool and porches, fishing boats and nets, loaves and fish, lamps and torches, coins, cords, basin and towel, palm branches, donkey, cross, crown of thorns, tomb, linen burial cloths, spices, and locked room.
depiction_rules: Show Jesus as a Jewish man; distinguish his ordinary, crucified, and risen appearances.
Depict God the Father, the Holy Spirit, and Satan/the devil as supernatural realities rather than ordinary human bodies unless a scene explicitly calls for symbolic form.
Depict angels as luminous or otherwise recognizably nonhuman messengers.
Use historically grounded Roman and Jewish settings and avoid later medieval visual conventions.
